description: With family or friends, come and enjoy your stay in this elegant apartment, located in the heart of Paris, in the famous Concorde district.The spaceWith family or friends, come and enjoy your stay in this elegant apartment, located in the heart of Paris, in the famous Concorde district.Whether it is the Champs-Élysées, the Opera, the Tuileries Gardens or the prestigious Place Vendôme and its luxury boutiques, you can visit everything with only a short walk.This apartment, which is a little jewel combining modernity and comfort, is located on the 1st floor of a building with elevator.The spacious living room has a sitting area with a sofa bed for 2 people, a dining table for 6 and an American kitchen equipped with a stove, microwave oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, toaster, kettle and coffee maker.There are two bedrooms, one with a double bed and the other with two single beds.You will have at your disposal a bathroom with Italian shower, a separate toilet and other equipment such as a washing machine, a dryer, an iron and an ironing board.You have access to the entire accommodation where you will find all the essential products for comfort and hygiene such as sheets and linens, towels, soap, shampoo and you benefit from an internet access.A preparation and a cleaning worthy of a hotel standard are reserved for you before your arrival.A Weekome receptionist will come personally to welcome you and give you the keys. At the same time, he will give you all the necessary information so that you can fully enjoy your stay.Additional information:Check-in is usually between 15:00 and 20:00. However, we accept late arrivals for your convenience. Please note that additional charges apply for late arrivals, as follows:After 20:00: €20After 10:00 pm: €40After midnight: €60Thank you f
